head: Eclipsed
body: A dark fantasy role-playing game. You wake in a cage beneath an old house. The first voice you hear belongs to a doll.
aside: Scroll to follow the stranger from the house into the realm.

head: A voice in
body: There’s a doll beside your cage. She speaks as though she’s been expecting you. For now, she knows something you need: a way out.
aside: Follow her voice. Find the stairs. Step into daylight.

head: The square
body: In the village square, two people face the gallows for sheltering a woman who fled the church. A crowd has gathered. Will you speak against the hanging, or cheer with them?
aside: Even here, among strangers, what you say matters.

head: Someone
body: Farther on, the Veyne sisters lead a hidden village. A wounded deserter begs for shelter. His pursuers want him back. This time the question is who you’ll stand beside.
aside: You build trust one person at a time.

kicker: IV  /  A moment on the road
head: When words
body: Picture an enemy closing the distance. Raise a shield at the right moment and you can stagger them. Or set down a carved board called a Relief, step within its reach, and cast a spell.

head: Beyond the
body: The road reaches the Kingdom’s capital. The Crown rules above; the Thieves have their own society below. A title might open a door, but it won’t tell you whom to trust.
aside: There are other roads: to the Templars of Iron Vow Hold, or east into the Cult’s village of Vesper Hollow.

head: Who will walk
body: Go alone, or bring friends. Up to four people can share a campaign. You travel through the same world, but the answers you give and the relationships you build are your own.
aside: The rest is yours to discover.
